reason: Results-only async IndexedDB registration cannot replace synchronous completion staging without reintroducing loss before transaction commit. Actual held transaction closure leaves no committed row despite successful add request; no durability acknowledgment was issued.
proposal: Pre-enroll an immutable, unique per-battle-instance slot in a bounded IndexedDB account directory BEFORE any fresh paid entry is requested. After committed enrollment, use that unique slot key for synchronous localStorage completion storage. Recovery queries the account index, then reads at most four known slot keys rather than enumerating unrelated origin storage. Directory commit is before financial exposure, synchronous completion write is before delayed send.
ordering: Allocate unique instance/slot/request identity and parent entry intent, without tokens. Commit directory enrollment transaction and validate current account/guild fence; only then permit exact paid entry request.
Entry recovery reuses the saved intent; a reload cannot silently allocate a fresh paid entry. Server attempt ID binds to the saved directory instance via a checked durable transition before launch.

Deep-copy completed battle packet; synchronously write it under the enrolled instance's unique key and verify exact readback before timer/network. Failure preserves directory and entry identity and refuses result send, never creates a fresh paid replacement.

Under conditional exclusive account Web Lock, discover only the indexed enrolled slots; validate exact account/guild/parent/packet, hold competing results, and retain current session fences through response handling.

After confirmed matching result, cleanup is explicit recoverable state: a short indexed transaction marks confirmation/cleanup identity, then matching slot removal and directory retirement. A crash between stores must not discard an unconfirmed transcript or replay a paid entry.
unresolvedCriticals: The directory and localStorage are separate stores, not one atomic transaction. Crash points and cleanup ordering need naturally failing controls and native evidence.

A quota/denial at synchronous completion can still lose an unsaved RAM transcript after tab closure. Pre-entry reservation/capability checks do not guarantee future quota. No universal exactly-once client reward claim.

Each concurrent battle instance needs its own enrolled unique slot. Shared-slot read/check/write is not CAS and must not be used to claim immutability. Restored attempts, repeated-click instance allocation, stale ownership and same-intent conflicting transcripts need explicit refusal/selection rules before implementation.

A crash after directory enrollment but before paid entry leaves an empty enrolled slot. It must not be automatically deleted if a charge may have committed. Server receipt status and exact recovery intent govern decisions; unknown/pruned/403/409 must remain refusal, not fresh payment.
Legacy unindexed results and mixed old clients remain an enrollment/migration gate. Never ignore legacy evidence or delete unrelated keys to free space. No migration/live cutover authorized.
Bounded directory cap must be transactional and account-scoped. Four entries is a private prototype refusal bound, not a approved gameplay limit or policy change.
nextPrivateControls: Separate hybrid directory/slot adapter prototype; register-before-paid callback cannot run before transaction completion or on abort.
Completed packet must survive closing the tab immediately after verified synchronous slot write while network/account lock is busy; unrelated global keys must not affect bounded lookup.
Concurrent enrollment/repeated clicks/empty directory entries/altered same intent/conflicting results and cleanup crash points preserve evidence and never trigger fresh paid intent.
Native denial/quota and legacy enrollment remain explicit unverified gates, not synthetic pass credit.
authority: Private prototype preparation only. No server/game cutover, money/reward/price/ownership policy changes, Brain work, shipping or deployment. Existing candidates and evidence preserved.
